channel.title: Anish Udupa N — Engineering Notes
channel.description: Technical notes on distributed systems, FastAPI security, Linux daemons, and backend engineering.

item.title: Routing Compute Workloads Across Heterogeneous LAN Nodes Without a Heavy Cluster Manager
item.description: Notes on building a lightweight master-worker orchestrator in Python: capability discovery, heartbeat timeouts, and avoiding head-of-line blocking on mixed hardware.

item.title: Designing Ephemeral Document Delivery with FastAPI and Android FLAG_SECURE
item.description: Threat modeling client-side document leaks: why encrypted transport alone is insufficient, how short-lived decryption keys work on mobile clients, and where OS protections stop.

item.title: Eliminating Periodic Scraping Signatures with Randomized systemd Timers and Decoy Traffic
item.description: Why fixed cron intervals get flagged even with clean browser fingerprints, and how a master systemd timer interleaving local-LLM decoy queries breaks periodicity.
